values: 一名善于正面作战的战士，会在击败敌人后变得更强。
A Warrior who thrives in head-on combat and becomes stronger with each kill.
有敌情？哼……正好一网打尽！
I see enemies... Hmph! It's time to slaughter them.
嗯？提高警惕！别让敌人钻了空子！
Hm... Stay alert. I sense enemies nearby.
It's a little rowdy in here.
我看到了很多强大的战士
There are many strong warriors here. Good.
戈丹是雅库伯尔最强的战士之一。与只懂使用蛮力的战士相比，他思考得更多，想要的也更多。
Kordan is one of the most formidable Wildborn warriors. Unlike his peers, he is more thoughtful and desires more than mere victory.
在成为首领之前，戈丹被称为“雅库伯尔之牙”。无论是单打独斗还是率队突袭，他的攻势都会像猛兽的尖牙一样撕碎敌人。
Before he made it as the chief, Kordan was known as "The Fang", for his ferocious ability to tear through enemy defenses like a wild beast.
与呼临人交战的过程中，戈丹逐渐意识到：巧计常常能胜过蛮力。但他始终对此不屑一顾，甚至将其归因为呼临人特有的狡诈。
During his battles with Halia, Kordan began to see that clever strategy often beats sheer brute force. Still, he dismissed it, chalking it up to the Halians' natural cunning.
据说戈丹唯一一次露出笑容，是他的女儿欧布出生之时。
Rumor has it that the only time Kordan ever smiled was when his daughter, Oboe, was born.
戈丹的声音极为浑厚，有不少年幼的孩子都曾经被他吓哭过。

Oboe once painted her father's battle face in bright, silly colors while he slept. Flustered, he grumbled at first, but her proud little grin won him over. "You're the prettiest warrior in the Wildborn tribe," she declared.
年轻的战士时常害怕遭到戈丹的严厉训斥。但当他们真的陷入险境时，率先冲来解救他们的人一定是戈丹。
Young warriors fear Kordan's stern demeanor, yet when danger strikes, Kordan is always the first to come to their aid.
雅库伯尔选拔首领的方式很简单：挑战上一任首领并且获胜之人，就是新首领。在戈丹担任首领的期间，从未有人成功过——除了率众离开雅库伯尔的缇洛亚。
In the Wildborn tribe, anyone who defeats the chief can take their place. However, no one has ever bested Kordan, except Tilaya, who eventually left the tribe.
戈丹曾私下向巫祭长老蒙多询问应该如何与女儿欧布相处。巧的是，欧布也私下问过同样的问题。
Kordan once consulted High Priestess Modra for advice on how to get along with his daughter. Ironically, his daughter had also asked Modra a similar question.
戈丹没有参与过猎血节，因此与狩猎神赐予的武器和神力无缘。尽管他未曾直言过，但与他亲近之人都看得出他一直为此事而遗憾。
Kordan has never joined the Bloodhunt Festival. Though he never speaks of it, those close to him can see his disappointment at missing out on the Hunting Goddess' divine weapon.
戈丹的铁面无私有目共睹。即便是他的亲人，一旦对雅库伯尔无用，他也会遵守雅库伯尔的传统驱逐对方，从无破例。
Kordan is known for his even-handedness. He upholds the Wildborn custom of casting out anyone deemed useless, showing no leniency, not even to his kin.
你想知道关于自己的传说？
You want to hear stories about yourself?
乌云低压。该让蒙多做一次占卜。
The sky looks heavy today. Maybe Modra should read the signs again.
很简单。向前任首领发起决斗，然后胜过他。
Easy. You just challenge the last chief and win the duel.
Why are you looking at me?
It's a little rowdy in here.
I didn't expect to see you again.
